summary: Fire lookout at Clairville, Kent County, dated 1958 by Canada Lookouts; a report for the year to March 1959 describes an 80 ft Ajax steel tower.

facts.design: 24.4 m (80 ft) galvanized steel Ajax fire lookout tower
facts.agency: New Brunswick Department of Lands and Mines (annual report, as quoted on Canada Lookouts)

events.note: Canada Lookouts dates the entry to 1958; the quoted report covers the year ending 31 March 1959, so the build month is not given

evidence.supports: Tower erected at Clairville, Kent County, as a new 80 ft Ajax galvanized steel tower
evidence.quote: A new 80' Ajax galvanized steel fire lookout tower was erected at Clairville, Kent County
1958: "A new 80' Ajax galvanized steel fire lookout tower was erected

evidence.supports: Report is the 122nd annual report, for the year ending 31 March 1959
evidence.quote: 122nd Annual report of the Department of Lands and Mines, year ending 3/31/1959

evidence.supports: Site overlooks forest land at the headwaters of three rivers
evidence.quote: on a site overlooking a large area of forest land on the headwaters of the Salmon, Buctouche and Richibucto Rivers

evidence.supports: Planned VHF radio link to ranger offices and to lookouts at Indian Mountain, Laketon, Blackville and Chipman
evidence.quote: Communication from this lookout station will be by VHF radio to ranger offices and to adjacent lookout stations at Indian Mountain, Laketon, Blackville and Chipman

evidence.supports: Community in Weldford Parish, about 5.3 km northeast of Coal Branch
evidence.quote: Clairville is a community in Weldford Parish, New Brunswick, located 5.34 km NE of Coal Branch

evidence.supports: On the road to Jailletville, on Route 465
evidence.quote: on the road to Jailletville on Route 465

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Canada Lookouts labels the entry 1958, while the quoted report covers the year ending 31 March 1959. The story uses 1958 and gives no month.

notes_for_editor: One secondary source for the tower: Canada Lookouts quotes the 122nd annual report of the Department of Lands and Mines (year ending 31 March 1959) and labels the entry 1958. The build month is not given, so the story gives none. Wikipedia confirms the community's place in Weldford Parish and its position on Route 465; that article is flagged as needing citations. No NHLR or FFLOS page for this tower is in the local crawl cache. Two WebSearch calls (one of them on the neighbouring lookouts) found nothing on the tower's staffing, removal or present condition. The brief's status, access and kind are left as unknown because no source supports a value. The brief's 1958 date matches the Canada Lookouts label, so no correction is proposed. The brief's coordinates (46.3846, -65.099) were not checked against a source. Confidence is low: one quoted report, and no source on the later history or the site today.
